name: peculiar-ragdoll/Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-GGUF-MTP model card
notes: Fetched 2026-10-21. Repo created 2026-08-24, MIT, base_model ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B (quantized). GGUF-only repo (no safetensors blob list), 1,909,809 downloads at read time, the most-downloaded Tiel variant (plain GGUF 300,752; Cyber-Tiel 736,645). The card publishes its benchmark evidence as IMAGES with alt text rather than a table: 'SWE-bench-Live: Tiel solves 12 of 25, level with Opus 4.6 and ahead of KAT-Coder, Nail, stock Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Ornith'; 'SWE-bench-Live: Qwen3.8-27B solves 16 of 25 at 50.2 minutes per attempt, Dirk 15 at 20.1, TielCoder 12 at 8.6, stock ...'; 'MMLU-Pro: Tiel 73.7 against Nail 84.0, both at 4-bit, with the control arm isolating the template'. Prose: 'against the base it is 3.8 points up on answer quality and 5.1 down on clarifying'. The 12/25 figure is n=25 single run, so each solve is worth 4 points: 12 vs 8 for the base is one solve apart in 4 of 25, i.e. within noise. Card also publishes a quant-tier size table (Q2_K_XL 12.7 GB through Q8_K_XL 38.8 GB, Q4_K_XL 22.7 GB = 'start here') and a speculative-decoding sweep (draft-n 1 / p-min 0.0 gives 94.4 tok/s, 1.22x, 83.3% acceptance; draft-n 8 collapses to 0.60x).
